name: infinite-bookshelf
description: Turn a topic into a complete book, written live by the AI model of your choice.

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && cd api && uv sync
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web test && cd api && uv run pytest
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web lint && pnpm --filter @infinite-bookshelf/web test && cd api && uv run pytest
